questionFeedback:
Sorry, that's not correct.
Explanation:


Conclusion I: All TV are Mobile is a possibility.
In a statement only few TV are Mobile means there is only some part of TV is Mobile, not whole TV can be Mobile.
So, conclusion I does not follows.
Conclusion II: All LED are not Mobile.
In a Venn-diagram we can Clearly see that all LED are not Mobile. So, conclusion II does not follow.
